scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run db:generate && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd frontend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd frontend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:generate: cd frontend && npx prisma generate && cd ../backend && npm run db:generate
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=backend run lint && npm --workspace=frontend run lint
scripts.check-all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
